profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hipcamp
profile.summary: I am a detail-oriented software developer. I have worked on systems ranging from futures and options trading applications to report generation and validation systems for large enterprise merchants. My interests lie primarily in anything surrounding data, from data engineering and creating validation pipelines to data science and machine learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the Reporting Products team, where we generated reports such as daily transaction fee reports and statements to ensure merchants can reconcile. Responsibilities included maintaining and building out new features for our reporting systems, addressing operational issues surrounding our reports, and improving operations by automating report validations. Worked primarily in Java with Apache Spark/ Spark SQL, and also worked in Python with Apache Airflow.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on Delta One (Futures Trading) and Stock Option Trading teams. Responsibilities included maintaining and building new features for trading applications, systems used for monitoring/ auditing applications, and deep diving and doing analysis on sometimes unexpected application behavior. Worked primarily in C, C++, and Python with a bit of Java and C#.

positions.title: EECS 203 Instructional Aide
positions.description: Spring 2017 Instructional Aide for EECS 203, Discrete Mathematics. Responsibilities included leading a discussion section, holding office hours, answering questions on the class discussion forum (Piazza), and writing homework/ exams.

positions.title: EECS 485 Instructional Aide
positions.description: Instructional Aide for EECS 485, Web Databases and Information Systems. Responsibilities included leading a discussion section, holding office hours, answering questions on the class discussion forum (Piazza), and designing projects/ exams. Also wrote an autograder for a project on Single Page Applications in Node.js using PhantomJS.

positions.title: Computer Consultant II
positions.description: Responsibilities included maintenance of Michigan Dining's Point of Sale system, as well as maintenance of students' meal plans and Blue Bucks/ Dining Dollars (on-campus currency). Also worked on various projects built with a standard web frontend and a Google Apps backend.

positions.title: EECS 203 Grader
positions.description: Graded student assignments and gave them constructive criticism to help them understand their mistakes.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Worked on Delta One (Futures Trading) team. Primarily worked on building new features for and maintaining C++ trading applications.

educations.schoolName: University of Michigan College of Engineering

projects.title: Overtime Log
projects.description: Created a web application with a Google Apps Script backend that would allow managers at Michigan Dining Halls to keep track of and print reports of overtime done by full time employees.

projects.title: Songify
projects.description: Created a Java app with three others that takes Twitter hashtags as input, finds top tweets using that hashtag, and uses those hashtags to make music. Made in 36 hours for MHacks 6.
